title: Binance Adds GMX, SNM & More Pairs on Cross Margin and Isolated Margin
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has added  GMX  and  SNM  as a new borrowable asset on  Cross   Margin  and  Isolated   Margin , as well as new margin pairs. New Cross Margin Pairs:  ATA/BUSD ,  ATA/USDT ,  DEGO/BUSD ,  DEGO/USDT ,  ERN/BUSD ,  ERN/USDT ,  GMX/BUSD ,  GMX/USDT ,  HIGH/BUSD ,  HIGH/USDT ,  LIT/BUSD ,  LIT/USDT ,  RSR/BUSD ,  RSR/USDT ,  SNM/BUSD New Isolated Margin Pairs:   GMX/BUSD ,  GMX/USDT ,  SNM/BUSD Explore Binance Margin Now! Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits and rates.
